name: jcas-mcp
description: Control macOS apps via AppleScript/JXA: pre-built sanitized commands plus script execution tools.
long_description: MCP server exposing AppleScript automation for macOS. Ships command sheets for 12 built-in apps (Messages, Mail, Reminders, Calendar, Notes, Finder, Safari, Music, Terminal, System Settings, Xcode, Speech Recognition) with type-aware argument sanitization, plus tools to execute AppleScript or JXA, check script syntax, and preview generated scripts. Set JCAS_SAFE_MODE=1 to disable arbitrary-code tools.
